operations.title: The Riemann theta kernel is not Pólya-frequency of infinite order
operations.statement: Schoenberg's theorem makes the bilateral Laplace transform of a PF-infinity function the reciprocal of an entire Laguerre-Polya function. The super-exponentially decaying Riemann theta kernel has entire transform Xi(is). If it were PF-infinity, the identity theorem would force Xi(is) to be zero-free, contradicting known nontrivial xi zeros. Thus total positivity must arise, if at all, only after the logarithmic Stieltjes transform.
operations.scope: Unconditional no-go for full translation-kernel total positivity; weaker finite-order and derived Pick/Stieltjes positivity remain open.
